reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29. Avant's transparency API latest balance-sheet snapshot is dated 2026-08-25 and reports net NAV $132,520,233.75. Its category breakdown reports net stablecoin exposure $132,505,616.90, positive Other $16,902,033.48, ETH/derivatives $4,855.66, AVAX/derivatives $2,754.29, BTC/derivatives $3.97, and perpetual hedges -$16,895,041.40. The residual non-stablecoin net exposure is $14,616.85. Percentages below normalize those two net categories to NAV (99.989% and 0.011%), without scaling gross or signed positions into fictitious reserves. The stablecoin category remains a basket because long and short positions are not published as a reconciled, holder-exitable allocation by tracked dependency.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Avant Protocol avUSD transparency API net asset breakdown dated 2026-08-25; category values normalized to reported net NAV
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The API publishes a net stablecoin category but does not provide a clean supply-weighted split by individual tracked stablecoin; gross long/short legs, strategy counterparties, and off-chain custody terms remain unresolved.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The live API shows assets deployed across Aave, Morpho, Kamino, Curvance, Jupiter, Ethena, Euler, Silo and other DeFi protocols, plus bridges/exchanges and treasury wallets. Avant docs state strategies are executed on-chain and with partners such as 0xPartners, but do not disclose legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms.
